_comment: Tier-2 for kratos.mpm pitfall #6: MPM boundary conditions attach to sub model parts of Background_Grid, never of MPM_Material. Executed 2026-08-07 on Kratos 10.4.3 Release with MPMApplication, using a self-written two-mdpa deck (no data files). Measured: the identical constraints_process_list block initialises when model_part_name is 'Background_Grid.DISPLACEMENT_fix' and raises RuntimeError 'Error: There is no sub model part with name "DISPLACEMENT_fix" in model part "MPM_Material"' followed by 'The following sub model parts are available:' when it is 'MPM_Material.DISPLACEMENT_fix'. The trap is that solver_settings.model_part_name IS 'MPM_Material', so the wrong root is the one a user naturally copies; the physical reason for the rule is that material points move while the grid does not, so a constrained region must be a grid region. Materials are the mirror image and address the body as 'Initial_MPM_Material.<name>'. SECONDARY VALUE: this is a live capture of the REAL Kratos missing-sub-model-part diagnostic. An earlier audit found catalog entries quoting an invented 'SubModelPart not found', a string that appears in zero files of the installed distribution; the genuine message enumerates the sub model parts that DO exist, which is the part that actually helps. INTERPRETER: needs a Kratos build carrying MPMApplication; set KRATOS_PYTHON. MUTATION CONTROL (T2_MUTATE=1, re-runnable): the mutation SWAPS the two model-part roots, so the deck expected to initialise now points at MPM_Material and the deck expected to fail points at Background_Grid; only the deck changes, the assertion machinery does not. Verified: unmutated PASSES (rc=0) with constraint_root_mismatches=0; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1), the count goes to 2 and both initialises[...]_expected=... lines flip. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/mpm_boundary_conditions_live_on_the_grid && $KRATOS_PYTHON source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 $KRATOS_PYTHON source.py (fails).
expect_in_output: There is no sub model part with name "DISPLACEMENT_fix" in model part "MPM_Material"
The following sub model parts are available:
